segments.name: Manufacturing carbonated beverages
segments.description: Manufactures and sells branded natural, premium, and functional carbonated beverages under Reed's and Virgil's brand names.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates in a single reportable segment, which consists of manufacturing carbonated beverages under Reed's and Virgil's brand names and comprises the financial results of the Company.

revenueModel.text: Sells branded beverages to retailers including natural stores, grocery chains, mass merchants, club stores, convenience stores, liquor stores, and restaurants, and directly to consumers online.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell to well-known popular natural food and gourmet retailers, large grocery store chains, mass merchants, club stores, convenience and drug stores, liquor stores, industrial cafeterias (corporate feeders), and to on-premises bars and restaurants nationwide and in some international markets.

changes.text: In 2019, the company streamlined its focus to core brands Reed's Ginger Beverages and Virgil's Craft Sodas.
changes.evidence: In 2019, we streamlined our focus to core brands: Reed's Ginger Beverages and Virgil's Craft Sodas.

changes.text: In 2021, the company entered the alcohol space with the launch of RTD Classic Mule and RTD Hard Ginger Ale.
changes.evidence: In 2021, we entered the alcohol space with the launch of our RTD Classic Mule that is 7% alcohol by volume ("ABV") and our RTD Hard Ginger Ale which is 5% ABV.

changes.text: In 2025, the company launched a new multi-functional soda line formulated with organic ingredients.
changes.evidence: In 2025, we launched a new multi-functional soda line that is formulated with organic ingredients.
